verdict.rationale: Cline documents strong programmatic control via its CLI (headless mode, scripting, processable output), ACP protocol integration, and hub-based scheduling, and claims 'the same core engine' powers CLI, Kanban, extensions, and custom integrations (cline-docs-3, cline-docs-19, cline-docs-26, cline-docs-23). However, a probe for a formal public API spec (OpenAPI/Swagger) returned all 404s, indicating no discoverable documented REST/API surface beyond the CLI/ACP interfaces. Missing for 10: an actual published API reference/spec, SDK documentation, or authentication/versioning details for a public API.
